title: flova.ai: AI Video Agent powered by Seedance 2.0
summary: A full-stack AI filmmaking platform that utilizes the Seedance 2.0 multimodal engine for narrative video production. It supports multi-shot continuity, character consistency, and integrated audio synchronization for cinematic storytelling.
research_notes: Flova.ai orchestrates multiple models including Seedance 2.0 and scriptwriting agents to automate long-form narrative content creation. Faced early industry scrutiny over ultra-realistic actor replication.

evolution.summary: The platform transitioned from simple clip generation to a unified multimodal architecture in early 2026. ByteDance's Seedance 2.0 update introduced native lip-sync, director-level camera controls, and the ability to process up to 9 reference images for consistent character rendering across different scenes.
